title: 第17章 嚣张至极第18章 楚云出手杀人诛心
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
“今年咱们来玩点新鲜的，去年都是学员比试，今年我们来一场长老比试如何？”
“长老比试？”
北灵院长皱眉。
不过很快便反应过来。
往年学员比试，都是他们北灵学院输。
现在对方想进行长老比试，明摆着是想踩了学员，又想来踩长老。
假如长老比试也输给对方，那么就会被对方笑话！
想明白其中的利害关系后，北灵院长脸色阴沉。
之前学员比试，只是切磋。
但是这次长老比试，却关系到北灵学院的名声。
他们绝不能输。
目光凝视两人，当发现两人只有地武境九重修为后，他嗤笑道：“我们学院长老都是天武境修为，而你们只有地武境九重，要是我派天武境长老跟你们比武，那别人还以为我欺负你们。”
其中一名老者道：“我听说你们外院长老都是地武境修为，这样，我大方一点，只要是地武境武者，都可以跟我们比试。”
“对，而且允许他们二打一。”
另外一名圆脸老者附和道。
“什么，二打一，太狂妄了。”
“简直没有把我们北灵学院放在眼里。”
“之前踩我们学员，现在又想踩我们长老，是可忍孰不可忍。”
“院长，答应他们。”
“对，今天就算死，我也要让他们知道我们北灵学院不是好惹的。”

外院的长老听到这话，个个愤怒不已。
但是北灵院长却十分冷静。
两人的修为，他已经看出是地武境九重巅峰。
很明显，人家是有备而来。
如果贸然动手，很可能会输。
但要是不答应，岂不是让对方笑话。
而且二打一，他们的胜算还是很大。
当下道：“既然要求是你们提的，要是我不答应，岂不是不给你们面子。”
北灵院长看着在场的外院长老道：“你们谁愿意出来和他比试一番？”
听到这话，楚云明显感觉到马脸老者向后退了退。
就算二打一，显然他也没有胆量上场。
“我来。”
就在这时，一名身材魁梧，留着少许胡须的中年人走了出来。
只见他看着阴阳学宫两名长老，拱手道：“在下宋毅，请赐教。”
两人淡淡一笑，其中长着圆脸的老者道：“地武境九重，你是一个人上，还是再找一个帮手？”
宋毅道：“我虽然只有地武境九重，但是却有堪比地武境九重巅峰的实力，所以我一个人足够。”
两个人打人家一个人，就算赢了也胜之不武。
content_en:
"Let's do something new this year. Last year it was all about student competitions. How about we have an elders competition this year?"
"A competition among the elders?"
Dean Beiling frowned.
But he quickly reacted.
In previous student competitions, Beiling Academy always lost.
Now the other party wants to hold an elder competition. It is obvious that he wants to step on the students and also wants to step on the elders.
If you lose to the other party in the elder competition, you will be laughed at by the other party!
After figuring out the stakes, Dean Beiling looked gloomy.
In the past, students competed and competed, just to learn from each other.
But this elder competition is related to the reputation of Beiling Academy.
They must not lose.
Gazing at the two of them, when he discovered that they were only at the ninth level of the Earth Martial Realm, he sneered and said: "Our college elders are all at the Tian Martial Realm, but you are only at the ninth level of the Earth Martial Realm. If I send the elders of the Tian Martial Realm to compete with you, others will think that I am bullying you."
One of the old men said: "I heard that your outer dean elders are all Earth Martial Realm cultivators. In this way, I will be generous and allow anyone who is an Earth Martial Realm warrior to compete with us."
"Yes, and they are allowed to fight two against one."
Another round-faced old man echoed.
"What, two against one, that's too arrogant."
"They simply don't take our Beiling Academy seriously."
"You trampled on our students before, and now you want to trample on our elders. This is unbearable."
"Dean, promise them."
"Yes, even if I die today, I will let them know that our Beiling Academy is not someone to be trifled with."
When the elders in the outer courtyard heard this, they were all furious.
But Dean Beiling was very calm.
He could already tell that the cultivation of the two of them was at the ninth level of the Earth Martial Realm.
Obviously, they came prepared.
If you do it rashly, you are likely to lose.
But if you don't agree, wouldn't you make the other party laugh?
And two against one, their chances of winning are still very high.
Immediately he said: "Since the request was made by you, if I don't agree, wouldn't I be denying you face?"
Dean Beiling looked at the other deans present and said, "Which of you is willing to come out and compete with him?"
Upon hearing this, Chu Yun clearly felt that the horse-faced old man stepped back.
Even in a two-on-one situation, he obviously didn't have the guts to play.
"I'll do it."
At this moment, a burly middle-aged man with a slight beard walked out.
He looked at the two elders of Yin Yang Academy, cupped his hands and said, "Song Yi, please give me some advice."
The two of them smiled faintly, and the old man with a round face said: "Ninth level Earth Martial Realm, are you going to do it alone, or are you going to find another helper?"
Song Yi said: "Although I am only at the ninth level of the Earth Martial Realm, I have strength comparable to the peak of the 9th level of the Earth Martial Realm, so I am enough on my own."
If two people beat one person, even if they win, they will still be defeated.
